context: Sakura plays in the park with Sho-young on a warm spring day.
purpose: Adult writer babysitting a child cousin; gentle play.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: さくらねえちゃん、ブランコ乗りたい!
lines.en: Sakura, can I go on the swing?
lines.style: Bright, immediate request. Bouncing energy in the opening. No hesitation—pure wish stated plainly. The eagerness of someone who trusts they'll be heard.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.en: Yeah, let's go to the playground.
lines.style: Warm, immediate agreement. Slight lift on the opening 「うん」. Natural, unhurried pace. The reassurance of someone who was already thinking yes.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ベンチで休んでてもいいよ!
lines.en: You can just rest on the bench if you want!
lines.style: Quick, considerate offer. Gentle excitement under it—he's solving a problem, proud of the solution. Soft on the ending, like he's giving permission.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.style: Soft, genuine. Small warmth in the acknowledgment. Settling tone—she's taking her place, comfortable in it. Fondness quietly underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Watch me—I'm going to go really high!
lines.style: Bright opening attack with certainty. Energy peaks on 「高く」. Breathless with the thrill of it. The proud announcement of someone about to do something brave.
